top_band: golden-brown layered thatched conical roof slope from row 1 to row 58 (about 57 rows around the doorway, or 48 rows directly above the central door arch)
evidence: The structure is a roundhouse with a large conical thatched roof (rows 1-58) seen from above/front, overhanging the cylindrical adobe/mud-brick wall (rows 59-77). There is a clear eave shadow (rows 59-61) cast by the thatch onto the wall, and the doorway in the center (rows 50-77) shows an inset frame with depth and a dark recessed interior.

style.evidence: The thatched roof has 6 distinct value steps from bright straw highlight on the upper-left to deep brown shadow on the right, with individual thatch bundle ridges and vertical texture throughout. The mud wall below is shaded cylindrically across multiple vertical value zones with brick/plaster markings and a stone base plinth, matching the Beodeul building references in craft and density.
